title: Invoice and credit numbers link with the date beside them, oldest first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts', 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is Markup % 25.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders and Part Sales in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $16.00, priced $20.00 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer A, with 2 units of a part in category A, cost $16.00 each, priced $20.00 each by tier A, one unit then returned, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
  3. Open tier A's row.
  4. Open customer A's row.
  5. Click work order 1's invoice number.
  6. Go back to Sales by Tier.
  7. Click the credit's number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's row reads Parts Invoiced $60.00 ($20.00 + 2 × $20.00) and Parts Credits −$20.00.

Step 3:

  • Customer A is listed.

Step 4:

  • Rows read "Invoice" with the number, a middle dot and today's date in gray, and the credit reads "Credit" with its number and date.
  • Invoices and the credit are listed by date, then by number, smallest first.

Step 5:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Finance tab.

Step 6:

  • Sales by Tier shows again.

Step 7:

  • The credit's PDF opens in a new browser tab.
